Case study summary

What did Juan build?

A product-education and inquiry website for residential and commercial sod customers.

This case study was last reviewed on July 26, 2026. Project details and limitations are identified throughout the page.

Role, audience and objectives

Responsibility carried through the system.

Juan's role

  • Strategy and information architecture
  • Visual and responsive design
  • SitePad development
  • Product education and content structure
  • Forms, business email, domain configuration, and launch

Audience

  • Residential property owners
  • Commercial buyers and project teams

Objectives

  • Explain sod choices in accessible language
  • Distinguish residential and commercial needs
  • Use installed work to add practical context

Behavioral lens

  • Learning through manageable comparisons
  • Clear cues for audience and product fit

Context

SIS Florida serves people who may know they need turf but not yet understand how varieties, installation conditions, and residential or commercial use affect the choice.

Juan’s role

Juan independently completed the strategy, information architecture, design, SitePad development, responsive implementation, content structure, forms, business email infrastructure, domain configuration, and launch process.

Design approach

The site pairs short product explanations with images of installed work. The goal is to help a visitor form a better question and choose a sensible next step—not to pressure a decision.

Evidence and limits

The live site confirms its product-education and inquiry structure. The domain date is shown as an approximate timeframe only.
